positions.title: Collections Specialist
positions.description:
-Negotiated account payments with debtors to reduce company’s amount loaned.  
-Educated customers on account financial data such as interest accruals, late fees, credit reporting, payment/account management options. 
-Secured customer payments via inter-company payment systems/tools.
-Collaborated on interdepartmental issues to produce customer solutions and agreements.

educations.schoolName: Kennesaw State University - Southern Polytechnic College of Engineering and Engineering Technology

volunteerExperiences.description: Created a systematic method to sourcing, building, and nurturing external partnerships in a scalable way that brings value to BAM Texas and Microsoft. Focused on collaborations, community involvement, community partnerships and volunteerism. Daily activities included scouting opportunities for partnership, acquiring partners and external resources, scheduling meetings between partners and internal resources, planning events with partners and the BAM committee, and cultivating relationships with partners and external resources.

projects.title: VMware Horizon Mirage
projects.description: Researched the mechanics of Mirage, how it works, and how to install/configure the desktop image manager. Transferred base/application layer images from server to client.

projects.title: Designing a WAN Network
projects.description: Designed a WAN network, connecting five sites in Georgia, through a switch and router, which transferred packets through a firewall. One site was designed as the remote site and one was assigned the data center.
